title: The truth James Sunderland hid in Silent Hill 2
subject: james
description:
Could you ever forgive James? 👇

The videotape that reveals what James Sunderland buried in his memory. Major spoilers for Silent Hill 2.

scenes.text: For the whole story, James Sunderland was lying to himself.
He believed his wife Mary died of her illness three years ago.
But that's not the truth. Three years ago was only when Mary got sick.
In room 312 of the Lakeview Hotel, James finds a videotape of their final days together.
It shows what he had buried. Worn down by her suffering, James ended Mary's life himself, not long before he came to Silent Hill.
The fog, the monsters and the letter were never a mystery about Mary. Silent Hill was forcing James to remember.
